name: meetergo
tagline: EU-hosted appointment scheduling with video, payments, workflows, CRM, and AI tools

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Light is €9.90 per user/month billed yearly, about $11 at the ECB reference rate, and includes unlocked scheduling, video calls, calendar and CRM integrations, and up to three workflows.

verdictSummary: A competent agent can build a useful personal booking page in a weekend, including availability rules, calendar blocking, confirmations, and rescheduling. Replacing meetergo as a business platform is a different job: dependable multi-calendar sync, team routing, payments, reminders, video, CRM, e-signatures, and GDPR operations turn it into a maintained product rather than a one-shot app.
coreLoopDIY: Publish a booking page, subtract calendar conflicts from configured availability, let a guest reserve a slot, create the calendar event, and send confirmation and rescheduling links.
whatYouLose: managed Google, Microsoft, and Apple calendar integrations
team round-robin, routing, and resource scheduling
built-in video, payments, CRM, and e-signatures
EU hosting, support, and compliance operations
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because a missed calendar update can cause a double booking, while team routing, reminders, payments, video, and compliance all need continuous operations. The subscription buys a maintained system whose integrations and delivery paths keep working, not just a booking-page UI.

priorArt.name: Cal.com
priorArt.desc: open-source scheduling platform that can be self-hosted

notes: Judge the personal scheduling loop separately from the much broader business suite.
prompt:
Build me a self-hosted personal appointment scheduler inspired by meetergo. Requirements:

- Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma, and SQLite; one admin
  user configured from .env, no multi-tenant accounts or telemetry.
- A public /book/[slug] page for 30- and 60-minute meeting types. Guests see
  the next 21 days in their local timezone, then enter name, email, and note.
- Weekly availability, date overrides, minimum notice, daily limits, and buffers
  live in an admin settings page. Store all timestamps in UTC.
- Google Calendar OAuth: read busy intervals before showing slots and create a
  calendar event with the guest invited after booking. Recheck the slot inside a
  database transaction so two guests cannot book it.
- Send confirmation, cancellation, and rescheduling emails through SMTP. Links
  use signed, expiring tokens and every change updates the calendar event.
- Add an admin agenda with upcoming bookings, status, guest details, and manual
  cancellation. Export bookings as CSV.
- Run a cron endpoint every ten minutes for one configurable reminder email.
  Make it idempotent so retries never send the same reminder twice.
- Docker Compose for the app and a persistent data volume, plus a nightly SQLite
  backup script that keeps 14 days. All secrets stay in .env.
- Tests for DST transitions, buffers, concurrent booking, cancellation, and
  reminder idempotency. Include seed data and a README with Google OAuth setup.
- Out of scope: Microsoft and Apple calendars, SMS, payments, built-in video,
  CRM, e-signatures, team routing, round robin, and formal compliance claims.
